module rtlpp_01170 (
  clk_25m,
  clk_100m,
  rst,
  pc,
  inst,
  alu_res,
  mem_wen,
  dmem_o_data,
  dmem_i_data,
  dmem_addr,
  hs,
  vs,
  vga_r,
  vga_g,
  vga_b
);

input wire clk_25m;
input wire clk_100m;
input wire rst;
input wire [31:0] pc;
input wire [31:0] inst;
input wire [31:0] alu_res;
input wire mem_wen;
input wire [31:0] dmem_o_data;
input wire [31:0] dmem_i_data;
input wire [31:0] dmem_addr;
output wire hs;
output wire vs;
output wire [3:0] vga_r;
output wire [3:0] vga_g;
output wire [3:0] vga_b;

// Hypothetical internal implementation of VGA module
  reg [9:0] h_count;
  reg [9:0] v_count;
  reg hs_reg;
  reg vs_reg;
  reg [3:0] vga_r_reg;
  reg [3:0] vga_g_reg;
  reg [3:0] vga_b_reg;

  always @(posedge clk_25m or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      h_count <= 0;
      v_count <= 0;
      hs_reg <= 0;
      vs_reg <= 0;
      vga_r_reg <= 0;
      vga_g_reg <= 0;
      vga_b_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
      // Horizontal counter
      if (h_count == 799) begin
        h_count <= 0;
        // Vertical counter
        if (v_count == 524) begin
          v_count <= 0;
        end else begin
          v_count <= v_count + 1;
        end
      end else begin
        h_count <= h_count + 1;
      end

      // Horizontal sync
      if (h_count >= 656 && h_count < 752) begin
        hs_reg <= 0;
      end else begin
        hs_reg <= 1;
      end

      // Vertical sync
      if (v_count >= 490 && v_count < 492) begin
        vs_reg <= 0;
      end else begin
        vs_reg <= 1;
      end

      // Simple color pattern
      if (h_count < 640 && v_count < 480) begin
        vga_r_reg <= (v_count < 160) ? 4'hF : 4'h0;
        vga_g_reg <= (v_count < 320) && (v_count >= 160) ? 4'hF : 4'h0;
        vga_b_reg <= (v_count >= 320) ? 4'hF : 4'h0;
      end else begin
        vga_r_reg <= 0;
        vga_g_reg <= 0;
        vga_b_reg <= 0;
      end
    end
  end

  assign hs = hs_reg;
  assign vs = vs_reg;
  assign vga_r = vga_r_reg;
  assign vga_g = vga_g_reg;
  assign vga_b = vga_b_reg;

endmodule
